probes.probe: curl 8.7.1 (curl UA) GET of CSV export endpoint, homepage, and two terms URL candidates

results.note: 796 bytes matches A2 recorded challenge size; body digest varies per request due to embedded nonce

probes.claim_audited: SSGA terms-of-use URLs serve JS SPA shells / redirect landings with no terms text to non-browser clients
probes.probe: curl with browser UA, tag-stripped visible-text measurement of two terms URL candidates; JS-rendering fetch (web reader) as adverse test

results.finding: generic intermediary landing shell; BYTE-IDENTICAL to A2 manifest probe_ssga_tou_a.html / ssga_legal_landing.html / ssga_terms_of_use_intermediary.html
choose-your-location redirect shell; BYTE-IDENTICAL to A2 manifest probe_ssga_tou_b.html / ssga_terms_of_use.html

even a JavaScript-rendering fetcher receives the HOMEPAGE (canonical https://www.ssga.com/us/en, template homepage-template) at this URL; the terms page content does not exist at the URL even with full JS. The only license-adjacent text obtainable anywhere is the homepage/footer disclosure: 'The whole or any part of this work may not be reproduced, copied or transmitted or any of its contents disclosed to third parties without SSGA's express written consent.' The SAME sentence is embedded in the footer of every downloaded SSGA workbook, including the staged navhist-us-en-spy.xlsx and spdr-etf-historical-distributions.xlsx.

probes.adverse_finding: The A2 claim 'no terms text obtainable' is incomplete: operative license text IS capturable by non-browser clients - embedded in the downloaded workbooks themselves - and it is ADVERSE: it forbids reproduction/copying/transmission without express written consent, i.e. it points AGAINST the local-storage and derived-research permissions FD0 item 3 requires. SSGA cannot ground FD0 even under the most favorable reading.

sweep_summary: Additional classes considered without dedicated probes because they are excluded by classification: Vanguard price-history downloads are login-gated (account boundary); other ETF issuers (Alpha Architect, First Trust, etc.) publish at most close-level NAV/market-price/distribution files, never OHLCV, and the large ones are bot-walled like iShares/Invesco/SSGA-website; SEC/EDGAR contains no daily market OHLCV; exchange publications (NYSE/Cboe DataShop) are account- or fee-gated; commercial APIs with free tiers (Massive/Polygon, Alpha Vantage, Tiingo, Finnhub, TwelveData, EODHD) all require account+API key = EXCLUDED_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED; unofficial mirrors (Kaggle/GitHub datasets) are not OFFICIAL sources under PLAN 4.1 item 1. No credible boundary-compliant path to FD0 was found.
